item.title: ASKING ERIC: Party attendee makes her own goodie bag
item.description: Dear Eric: There’s a gal in my social circle who makes a habit of attending birthday parties and, in addition to the piece or two of birthday cake she consumes at the party, wraps pieces of cake to take home “for my family.” Sometimes she even does it without asking permission.

item.title: FUTURE, PRESENT and PAST: FCHS membership preserves the past, offers present benefits
item.description: If you remember getting your tank filled for six bucks at Stengel Oil or Jim Spor’s 66, mixing Coke, Pepsi and Shasta in the same cardboard six-pack at Ted’s Market, or tossing peanuts over the moat at Monkey Island, then you’re part of Finney County History.

item.title: FAMILIES FIRST: Preparing a home to go on the housing market
item.description: My siblings and I are working on getting my late mother’s estate settled and we have decided to sell her home. I visited with a realtor and she confirmed what I had shared in a news column a few years back. I thought I would share it again as it is a great reminder for this time of year.

item.title: Black History Month event on Sunday
item.description: The United Presbyterian Church of Garden City is hosting a Black History Month event on Sunday, Feb. 22.

item.title: GCCC Speech, Debate team claims championship
item.description: Garden City Community College has announced that its Phi Rho Pi Speech and Debate team has been named the Division III Regional and State team champions, earning first place overall in the Team Sweepstakes at the Nebraska/Kansas Regional and State tournament for College Speech and Debate.
